finding_resolution.original_violation: Default SIGQUIT terminated an actually quarantined disposable owner and released its real temporary root flock without positive retirement.
finding_resolution.source_correction: execute blocks HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT while installing all four deferral handlers before any root-lock acquisition. It restores the original caller signal mask before lock acquisition and canonical child launch. During uncertainty, all four reach the installed deferral handlers; quarantine evidence failures are swallowed and the nonreturning sleep retries after BaseException. Successful safe-release cleanup closes the root flock before atomically restoring original handlers and caller mask.
finding_resolution.real_child_evidence: The independently rerun suite executes five serial real disposable children through actual execute, real temporary acquire_development_lock, uncertain run_checked and actual quarantine. Each child has unavailable quarantine evidence and a first wait exception. Four children separately survive HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT with independently opened flock contenders blocked. A fifth child has real stdout EPIPE and survives all four ordinary signals while still retaining its real flock. Readiness records prove the signals are unblocked and handlers callable. Tests then kill/reap only those exact owned disposable children and verify temporary locks become available.
finding_resolution.mask_and_healthy_build_boundary: Original mask is restored before acquiring ownership or invoking the canonical child; no widened child blocked-signal mask or changed heavy-command profile is introduced. Existing deferred-signals reporting remains active.
finding_resolution.sigkill_limit: No live flock can survive destruction of all its owning processes by SIGKILL. The tests deliberately kill/reap only their own disposable children after verifying ordinary-signal retention. Real crash recovery continues to depend on persistent reviewed exclusions; this review does not claim SIGKILL-resistant live flock ownership.
